title: Lightweight cross-functional checksum & rollup — 2026-04-13
content:
Purpose: quick checksum of outstanding cross-team one-offs we promised in the last sync; single-page rollup to hand to the oncall / scrum leads.

Notes:
- This is intentionally lightweight: 1 row per item, explicit next-owner, rough hours estimate (T-shirt).
- Use this to decide which items we push to next sprint vs keep as ad-hoc.
- Bring any disagreements to the 15m triage at 10:30.

Table (columns): Owner | Team | Short description | Next action | Est hours | Priority (H/M/L) | Status | Blockers / follow-up

Rows:
1) Aisha Patel | product-ops | Small eval run: baseline prompt set for v2 quantization across 2 models | Run eval (nightly) + capture regression metrics | 4h | H | in_progress | waiting for infra GPU slot (ticket JIRA-OPS-782)

2) Liam Chen | observability | Endpoint latency sample: add quick percentiles for 99/995 for routing policy B | Add new Prom query, push dashboard tile | 2h | M | todo | need access to dashboard write perms (SRE gate)

3) Sofia Martinez | solutions-eng | Customer demo checklist (DL for dedicated) — remove demo-only keys from logs | Remove keys, re-record demo steps, send to SEs | 3h | H | in_review | patch in PR-213; QA requested

4) Noah Rivera | infra | Burst capacity stub: run cost delta quick-scan for last 3 deploys | Small spreadsheet + annotated notes | 2h | M | todo | none

5) Kit (contractor) | devx | SDK doc patch: streaming examples missing edge-case | Draft code snippet + example app | 1.5h | L | todo | needs review by Aisha

6) Legal intake | legal | Data retention question for Private deployments (short) | Summarize ask and route to compliance | 1h | H | todo | linked to CONFLUENCE-12345

Quick totals: estimated immediate hours = 13.5h (team-sum). Priorities: 3 H, 2 M, 1 L.

Decision log (short):
- 2026-04-13 09:15 — Agree to treat #1 and #3 as showstoppers for this sprint; allocate small burst capacity. (Aisha)
- 2026-04-13 09:42 — #2 accepted as low-effort observability follow-up; can be done in next maintenance window. (Liam)

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Who can unblock infra GPU slot for the eval run? (SRE / infra)
- Confirm who owns publishing the updated SDK snippet to docs (devx lead)
- Do we want to roll the legal summary into the customer-facing privacy FAQ? (Product + Legal)

Quick checklist for handoff:
- [ ] Add these rows to sprint board (owner assigns ticket IDs)
- [ ] Triage any items that exceed 8h into a spike / ticket with acceptance criteria
- [ ] If blocked >24h, escalate to TLs via #ops-bridge

Notes to self: keep this file as the ephemeral single-source for the morning triage; once items are ticketed, link tickets back here.

Slack refs: #prod-ops, #infra-burst, #se-demo

Aisha (owner) — next update: 2026-04-14 10:00 (or earlier if blockers cleared).
